notes.title: Now available in your favorite language!
notes.content:
Hello, Snipers!

We are happy to announce a major language update to the game together with fixes for important issues!

You can now play Sniper 3D in your favorite idiom by selecting it on your Steam preferences:

+ German
+ French
+ Russian
+ Spanish
+ Simplified Chinese
+ Traditional Chinese
+ Japanese
+ Portuguese
+ Italian
+ Korean
+ Turkish
+ Arabic

How awesome is that? ːsteamhappyː

Please enjoy a more immersive experience as we continue to work on the background to solve the issues you told us about.

Keep up the good sniping and thanks for all who suggested improvements!

- The Fun Games For Free Team

notes.title: Fixes and Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello, Snipers!

We constantly monitor Sniper 3D Assassin's community to be informed of issues and possible improvements - so thanks to all of you who helped raising awareness on these!

Our newly released version contains a few improvements and bug fixes that we believe you are going to like. Here's what's new:

- Fixed issue with Assault Rifles
- All 150+ weapons re-rendered with better graphics
- New customized cursor for an immersive gameplay

Have fun and keep giving your valuable feedback!

- The Sniper 3D Assassin Team
